info.title: Convoy V3 API
info.description: # Convoy OS API — Front-end Guide One document per menu of Convoy OS. Each document lists the screen actions and the API call behind each one. | Menu | Document | | --- | --- | | Scheduler (rail icon `calendar_view_week`) and everything it opens | [scheduler.md](scheduler.md) | | Trips (rail icon `assignment`): Trips, Trip History, Notices, Bookings, Rate Cards | [trips.md](trips.md) | | Fleet (rail icon `directions_bus`): Vehicles, Drivers, Bus Attendants, External Vehicles, Fuel & Energy, Maintenance, Vehicle Types, and Transport Operators (Managed Operators, Operator Vehicles, Operator Drivers) | [fleet.md](fleet.md) | | Settings (rail footer icon `settings`): Company Settings, Users, Calendars, and the Profile dialog | [settings.md](settings.md) | | Clients (rail icon `corporate_fare`): Managed Clients, Client Users, and the Client Portal sign-in | [clients.md](clients.md) | | HR (rail icon `badge`): Drivers, Earnings, Pay Schemes, Rate Plans, Bonuses, Points, Rewards, Salary Simulator, Audit Log | [hr.md](hr.md) | | Finance (rail icon `account_balance`): Client Invoices, Documents, Operator Payments, Vehicle Financials, Finance Settings | [finance.md](finance.md) | **Integrating the API (or asking an AI assistant to)?** Start with [integration.md](integration.md): it is the one file to read first, and it points to everything else. **Building a screen?** [screen-map.md](screen-map.md) maps every screen and button of the Convoy OS prototype to its API call and the section that explains it. Read the conventions below first; the menu documents do not repeat them. **Apidog / OpenAPI:** [`convoy-v3-api.openapi.json`](convoy-v3-api.openapi.json) lists every endpoint (OpenAPI 3.0), one folder per resource inside its menu, with the description of the section here that names it and request / response examples recorded from the specs and the seed data. Import it in Apidog (Import → OpenAPI). It is generated, do not edit it by hand: after an API change run `bin/rails api_docs:all` (specs + seed probe + build), or `bin/rails api_docs:openapi` to rebuild from the last recorded examples. --- ## Base URL and format - All endpoints live under `/api/v1`, for example `GET /api/v1/scheduler`. - Request and response bodies are JSON (`Content-Type: application/json`), except file uploads (multipart, see below). - Keys are **snake_case**: `start_time`, `vehicle_id`, `trip_label`. - Dates are ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`. Times of day are `"HH:MM"` (24-hour) in requests and responses. A trip that ends after midnight still returns its end as `"HH:MM"` and sets `ends_next_day: true`. - Timestamps (`starts_at`, `created_at`...) are ISO 8601 with the company's offset, for example `2026-11-02T07:45:00+08:00`. - **Money, decimals and coordinates come back as strings**: `"price": "76.19"`, `"lat": "1.2722"`. Send them as numbers or strings. - Display formats (company Date Format / Time Format) are the front end's job. The only server-formatted text is human sentences such as warnings and summaries, which already follow the company's formats. ## Signing in (Bearer token) `POST /session` returns a token (JWT). Send it on **every** other request: ``` Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9... ``` - The token lasts **30 days** (`expires_at`); after that, or after sign-out, calls answer `401` and the app signs in again. - Each sign-in is its own token (one per device or browser). Signing out ends only that token. - No cookies are used. Web apps keep the token in memory or `localStorage` (never put user-typed HTML in the page); mobile apps keep it in the Keychain / Keystore. - Cross-origin web front ends must be allowed by the server (`CORS_ORIGINS`; staging accepts any `localhost` port). | Action | Call | | --- | --- | | Sign in | `POST /session` `{ "email": "...", "password": "...", "device_name": "iPhone 16" }` (`device_name` optional) | | Who am I (on page load) | `GET /session` | | Sign out (this token) | `DELETE /session` → `204` | | Convoy Admin picks the company to view (for this token) | `PATCH /session` `{ "company_id": 1 }` | `POST /session` response = the `GET /session` response below plus the token: ```json { "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_at": "2026-12-02T09:00:00+08:00", "user": { "...": "..." }, "company": { "...": "..." } } } ``` `GET /session` response: ```json { "data": { "user": { "id": 2, "name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "display_name": null, "shown_name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "email": "ops@simpledrive.sg", "mobile": null, "mobile_display": null, "role": "admin", "role_label": "Super Admin", "owner": true, "permissions": ["users", "vehicles", "finance", "..."], "initials": "SO", "avatar": null, "status": "active", "company_id": 1 }, "company": { "id": 1, "name": "SimpleDrive", "display_name": "SimpleDrive", "code": "SD", "country": "SG", "timezone": "Asia/Singapore", "date_format": "dmy", "time_format": "24", "theme_color": "#0B6E6E", "logo": null, "observed_holidays": "off", "business_units_enabled": false, "status": "active" } } } ``` - `role`: `convoy_admin` (Convoy staff, **view only**: every write returns `403`), `admin` (every permission), `member` (only `permissions`). `owner` = Super Admin. Show `shown_name` (display name or name) in the top bar. Users and the Profile: [settings.md](settings.md). - `company` is `null` for a Convoy Admin until `PATCH /session` picks one (per token: a new sign-in starts with none); company data then answers `422 "Pick a company first"`. - Sample accounts (seed): `ops@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Admin), `dispatch@simpledrive.sg` / `Simple123!` (Member, vehicles), `admin@convoy.sg` / `Convoy123!` (Convoy Admin). ## Responses Success: ```json { "data": { "...": "..." } } ``` Lists are paged: ```json { "data": [ "..." ], "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 50, "count": 132, "pages": 3 } } ``` - Paging: `?page=2&limit=100` (default limit 50, max 500). - Some lists add more to `meta` (counts for filter chips and so on); each endpoint says so. - Small lists (vehicle types, teams, holidays...) return every row without paging: `{ "data": [...], "meta": {} }`. - Text filters on lists use ransack keys: `?q[name_i_cont]=goo` (case-insensitive "contains"). Each endpoint lists its filters. ## Errors ```json { "error": { "code": "invalid", "message": "Enter the drop-off point", "details": { "base": ["Enter the drop-off point"] } } } ``` | Status | `code` | When | | --- | --- | --- | | 400 | `bad_request` | A required parameter is missing (`message` names it) | | 401 | `unauthorized` | No / bad / expired / signed-out token (`"Sign in to continue"`), or wrong email / password | | 403 | `forbidden` | Not allowed. Convoy Admin gets `"View only. Convoy Admin cannot change company data"` | | 404 | `not_found` | The record does not exist or belongs to another company | | 409 | `conflict` | Someone else changed the record (see `lock_version`) | | 410 | `gone` | A public tracking link has closed | | 422 | `invalid` / `unprocessable_content` | Validation failed or a business rule was broken; `message` is a sentence to show the user as is; `details` lists field errors | Show `error.message` in the toast. It is written for end users and matches the wording of the Convoy OS prototype. ## Optimistic locking (`lock_version`) Trips and runs carry `lock_version`. Send back the value you loaded when saving (`PATCH /trips/:id`, run actions); if someone else saved in between, the API answers `409` and the screen should reload. Leaving it out skips the check. ## Files (uploads and downloads) - Upload with `multipart/form-data`. Nested fields use bracket names, for example `vehicle[photo]`, `trip[stops_attributes][0][photos_attributes][0][photo]`. - Files are private. Any file in a response looks like: ```json { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/eyJfcmFpbHMi...", "thumb_url": "/api/v1/downloads/...", "name": "hiace.png", "size": 9273, "content_type": "image/png" } ``` - `url` / `thumb_url` are signed links valid for **1 hour** that open the file on their own (no `Authorization` header, like a pre-signed URL); use them directly in `` or open them in a new tab. They are paths: put the API host in front (`https://convoy-api-staging.convoy.sg` + `url`). Reload the record to get fresh links. Do not share them. - Images are resized to 1280 px; `thumb_url` is a 320 px square. Documents accept PDF, images, xlsx / xls, csv, doc / docx, txt (10 MB max). ## Reading documents with Claude (background reads) Log cards, insurance papers, workshop invoices, route lists and pasted trip messages are read by Claude in the background: 1. `POST /document_reads` with `kind` and a `file` (multipart) or `input_text` → **202** `{ "data": { "id": 7, "status": "pending", ... } }`. 2. Poll `GET /document_reads/:id` every 2–3 s until `status` is `done` (use `result`) or `failed` (show `error`). 3. When saving the form, send `document_read_id` so the server attaches the same file; there is no second upload. | `kind` | Used by | | --- | --- | | `log_card` | Edit Vehicle > Log Card | | `insurance` | Edit Vehicle > Insurance | | `maintenance_invoice` | Maintenance > Record the Work | | `route_list` | Trip form (School Run) > Import Route List | | `trip_message` | Trip form > Fill from Message (`input_text`) | ```json { "data": { "id": 7, "kind": "log_card", "status": "done", "error": null, "result": { "plate": "PD3318K", "make": "Toyota" }, "file": { "url": "...", "name": "card.pdf" }, "created_at": "...", "finished_at": "..." } } ``` Only the user who started a read can see it. Without an Anthropic key on the server, reads end `failed` with `"Reading with Claude is not set up (API key missing or not allowed)"`. ## Runs ("occurrences") The Scheduler works on **runs**: one row per trip (or School Bus route) per date, per shuttle timing, per vehicle slot. They are already resolved (times, bus, driver, price), so the screens only display them. - Runs exist up to **`meta.horizon` = today + 120 days**. Later dates have no runs yet: the server adds one date each night. Do not let users browse or act past the horizon (grey out those days, stop the › button there). - Changes made for the future are rules, not runs, so they reach later dates on their own as the horizon moves: an assignment From This Date On, Driver Away / Vehicle Down on a date range, Every Run From Today, Change a Day, public holidays, default driver changes, trip edits. Their date pickers may go past the horizon. - `id` identifies a run; `key` is a stable name for the same run across re-syncs: `t||||` or `r||0|1|1`.

tags.name: Common / Banks
tags.description:
Singapore banks for payment details (Managed Operators): the bank picker with branches, and the branch of an
account number as it is typed.

tags.name: Common / Document Reads
tags.description: Read a file or a message with Claude in the background: POST returns 202 with the read; poll GET until done or failed.

tags.name: Common / Downloads
tags.description: Serves private CarrierWave files behind a signed, expiring token (see Download); the link needs no Bearer header.

tags.name: Common / Sessions
tags.description: Sign in (Bearer token), sign out, who am I, and (Convoy Admin) which company to look at.

tags.name: Scheduler / Occurrences
tags.description:
Runs for drivers and admins (today, tomorrow, a date or a range; by driver, vehicle, trip, status), the drawer
detail, and what can be done to one run.

tags.name: Scheduler / Public Tracking
tags.description: Trip Tracking page (public, no sign-in): the run a shared link shows, while it is open.

tags.name: Scheduler / Replacements
tags.description:
Replacements: the Replace form (trip drawer: occurrence_id), Driver Away / Vehicle Down (vehicle panel: a date range
on original_vehicle_id), the Replacements list, and a preview of what a replacement would do before saving.

tags.name: Scheduler / Scheduler
tags.description:
The Scheduler grid for a date range (Day or Week): the vehicles (with the Scheduler's filters and sort), every run in
the range (runs exist up to meta.horizon; later dates are empty), the unassigned runs, and the nearest dates with unassigned runs
before and after the range.

tags.name: Scheduler / Trip Assignments
tags.description: Assign page of a trip: every run x vehicle slot with who runs it as of a date, the history, and give or take back.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Attachments
tags.description: Files on a booking (passenger list, itinerary), up to 10.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Cancel Requests
tags.description: A client's request to cancel a booking or one trip: recorded on their behalf, then accepted or declined.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Notifications
tags.description:
The bell for bookings: events of the last 14 days the user wants (new bookings from the Portal or the App, client
approval done or declined, changes accepted, cancellation requests), newest first, and how many are unseen.

tags.name: Trips / Booking Trips
tags.description:
One trip of a booking: Approve & Convert to Trip (or Approve Without Waiting), Reject, and the client's steps
recorded on their behalf (Client Acknowledged, client approval done / declined). Each returns the whole booking.

tags.name: Trips / Bookings
tags.description:
Trips > Bookings: tabs Pending, Approved, Rejected, Completed with search; booking details; Record Booking / Save
Changes; the estimate of a trip while the form is open.

tags.name: Trips / Notice Templates
tags.description: Notices > Templates: the usual wording, picked in the Notice form ({min} and {time} are filled in there).

tags.name: Trips / Notices
tags.description:
Notices page and Send Notice (trip drawer): tabs Active, Scheduled, Ended with search; End Now (active), Edit (scheduled),
Duplicate, Delete (not active).

tags.name: Trips / Rate Card Assignments
tags.description: Trips > Rate Cards > Client Rate Cards: which card each client is priced by (assigned, else the default card).

tags.name: Trips / Rate Cards
tags.description:
Trips > Rate Cards: list, view, new (the standard starting card), create, edit, Make Default, Archive / Unarchive,
warnings while editing; and Price From Rate Card (Corporate Shuttle in the trip form).

tags.name: Trips / Route Lists
tags.description:
Import Route List (School Run trip form): review a read list, apply it onto a saved School Run, the Earlier Lists,
and the Next 12 Months bill.

tags.name: Trips / Trip Attachments
tags.description: Attachments of a trip.

tags.name: Trips / Trip History
tags.description: Trips > Trip History: every run that ran, was cancelled or skipped, with filters, the record of one run and notes.

tags.name: Trips / Trip Run Groups
tags.description: Runs That Move Together (trip drawer): group run slots, or ungroup.

tags.name: Trips / Trip Stop Photos
tags.description: Stop photos from the trip drawer (up to 3 per stop, resized to 1280 px); the same photos the trip form shows.

tags.name: Trips / Trips
tags.description:
Trips (trip templates). Filters: kind, client_id, vehicle_id, from / to (trips that may run in the range), q (title,
client, label or a Trip ID).

tags.name: Fleet / Attendants
tags.description: Attendants

tags.name: Fleet / Drivers
tags.description:
Own drivers (Fleet > Drivers): tabs by status, invite with name and mobile, edit, the invite lifecycle,
View Details and the customer-facing copy (DriverInviteActions).

tags.name: Fleet / External Share Links
tags.description: External Vehicles > Share Form: the company's link for hired drivers (made on first use) and New link.

tags.name: Fleet / External Vehicle Submissions
tags.description: Share Form answers waiting below the link (Review and Add = POST /vehicles/external with submission_id, or Dismiss).

tags.name: Fleet / Fuel
tags.description: Fuel & Energy: the KPI row and the Usage card.

tags.name: Fleet / Fuel Alerts
tags.description: Fuel & Energy > Needs a Look: unusual fills of the last 90 days (FuelAlerts::Scan), Open / Checked tabs, Mark Checked, Undo.

tags.name: Fleet / Fuel Companies
tags.description:
Fuel Companies window (Fuel & Energy): the list (Singapore defaults on first use) with how many entries use each,
saved at once.

tags.name: Fleet / Fuel Entries
tags.description: Fleet > Fuel & Energy: the monthly log, vehicle cards, the entry form (with receipt reading) and delete.

tags.name: Fleet / Maintenance Visits
tags.description: Maintenance dialog (Scheduler toolbar, empty slot, Fleet > Maintenance): plan a visit, record the work, cancel.

tags.name: Fleet / Operator Drivers
tags.description: Operator Drivers: invited like own drivers (DriverInviteActions); an active one can sit on one bus of their operator.

tags.name: Fleet / Operators
tags.description:
Transport operators: managed (Managed Operators) and external (companies external vehicles are hired from).
The list adds the Routes column (School Bus routes their buses run) and the number of buses.

tags.name: Fleet / Public Share Forms
tags.description:
Share Form page (public, no sign-in): a hired driver sends the bus, their details and the company they drive for.
Throttled per IP in config/initializers/rack_attack.rb.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Driver Schedules
tags.description:
Default driver schedule of an own vehicle: history with periods, change from a date (can be ahead),
remove an upcoming change. Occurrences on the vehicle follow it (sync arrives with the occurrence engine).

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Insurance Documents
tags.description: Insurance files of a vehicle's current policy: add (upload or attach a read; up to 5), change kind, remove.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Insurance Policies
tags.description: Insurance of a vehicle (Edit Vehicle): current policy and Past Policies, edit, Renew Policy, delete a past policy.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Log Cards
tags.description: Log cards of a vehicle (Edit Vehicle): current and past, upload (or attach a read), pick the plate, delete a past card.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Teams
tags.description: Vehicle teams (Manage Teams): renaming keeps its vehicles; deleting a team leaves its vehicles without one.

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Type Requests
tags.description: Vehicle Types > Request a New Type (company) and Requests From Companies (Convoy Admin: Add Type / Decline).

tags.name: Fleet / Vehicle Types
Fleet / Vehicles
tags.description:
Vehicles, with the Scheduler's filters: ownership[] (own managed external), size[] (sedan mpv small medium large),
tags[], vip, team_id, q (plate, make, model, driver, operator), sort (type | smallest | largest).
meta.facets gives the counts for the filter chips (teams: chips of the Vehicles pages, by the ownership picked).

tags.name: Fleet / Workshops
tags.description: Workshops window: name, address, phone. One used by a visit can't be deleted.

tags.name: Clients / Client End Customers
tags.description: A client's end customers (nested under /clients/:client_id).

tags.name: Clients / Client Pickup Points
tags.description: A client's pickup points (nested under /clients/:client_id).

tags.name: Clients / Client Sites
tags.description:
A client's sites (nested under /clients/:client_id): Add Site, Edit Site (school, own billing, Send Invoices To),
Remove (refused while trips use the site).

tags.name: Clients / Client Users
tags.description:
Managed Clients > Client Users (nested under /clients/:client_id): people who sign in to the Client Portal, with their
role and site access; and the Client Portal roles (Role Permissions window).

tags.name: Clients / Clients
tags.description:
Managed Clients: the list (also the trip form's Client picker), Add / Edit (with the School link), the client record
page, and Delete (refused while trips are still running or bookings are open).

tags.name: Clients / Pickup Points
tags.description: Saved Pick-up Points (Import Route List window): Save Pick-up Point on a review stop, list, delete.

tags.name: Finance / Client Billing
tags.description:
Finance > Client Invoices > Billing Details of a client: UEN, billing address, the people who get invoices, terms
(days), default PO and the late-cancellation cut-off (hours). Sites billed as their own entity are edited on the site.

tags.name: Finance / Client Invoices
tags.description:
Finance > Client Invoices: Ready to Invoice (by billing entity), Ad Hoc Trips, invoices and credit notes (tabs),
Create Draft / Invoice Now, the invoice dialog (edit draft, Issue, Void, delete draft).

tags.name: Finance / Finance Documents
tags.description: Finance > Documents: every client invoice, credit note and operator payment notice, with the data to print one.

tags.name: Finance / Finance Settings
tags.description:
Finance > Finance Settings: GST, payment details, operator pay run approval, what documents show, document prefixes;
Save / Save & Lock, Lock, Unlock (Admin).

tags.name: Finance / Operator Payments
tags.description:
Finance > Operator Payments: Payment Requests (by operator), cost of a run, manual items, Approve and Set Pay Date,
Ad Hoc Payment, Batches (pay date, cancel, payments, Mark All Paid, bank file and payment notices).

tags.name: Finance / Vehicle Financials
tags.description:
Finance > Vehicle Financials (purchase and loan): own vehicles with their funding status, a vehicle's purchase, loan
and instalment schedule, the edit form (with the lender's schedule read by Claude), instalments marked paid.

tags.name: Finance / Vehicle Pl
tags.description:
Finance > Vehicle Financials (profit and loss): fleet and vehicle P&L by period and basis, cost spikes (Mark Checked),
due in the next 90 days, and manual revenue / cost entries.

tags.name: HR / Pay Audit Log
tags.description: HR > Audit Log: every change to pay, bonuses, points and rewards, with who made it and when (read only).

tags.name: HR / Pay Bonuses
tags.description: HR > Bonuses: list, bonus, Save / Save and Lock (the whole bonus), Lock / Unlock, Delete, and the period options.

tags.name: HR / Pay Drivers
tags.description:
HR > Drivers: own active drivers with the pay scheme and vehicle type used to work out their pay, and their dated
assignments (Assign Scheme / Assign Vehicle Type, change dates or the scheme / type, remove). Each change saves at once.

tags.name: HR / Pay Earnings
tags.description: HR > Earnings: each driver's pay this month from the Scheduler, the runs and the breakdown, Confirm / Reopen Month.

tags.name: HR / Pay Points
tags.description: HR > Points: drivers with their balance, a driver's balance card and history, Award / Deduct Points.

tags.name: HR / Pay Rate Plans
tags.description:
HR > Rate Plans: list, plan (periods, times, rates), Save / Save and Lock (the whole plan), Lock / Unlock, Delete,
and the Coverage grid.

tags.name: HR / Pay Rewards
tags.description: HR > Rewards: what drivers redeem points for (photo, title, description, points needed, active / inactive).

tags.name: HR / Pay Schemes
tags.description: HR > Pay Schemes: list, scheme, Save / Save and Lock (the whole scheme), Lock / Unlock, Delete.

tags.name: HR / Pay Simulator
tags.description: HR > Salary Simulator: work out a made-up month (nothing is saved), Fill Sample Month, and the five shared templates.

tags.name: Settings / Calendar Days
tags.description: Days on a calendar (also the Scheduler's Change a Day).

tags.name: Settings / Calendars
tags.description:
User calendars (school or general) with their days. New school calendars start from the MOE preset,
blank, or a copy of another calendar.

tags.name: Settings / Companies
tags.description:
Transport companies: Convoy Admin opens and manages them; company users read their own and (with the Users permission)
change Company Settings. Picking the country once stamps who and when; after that it is locked (country_requests).

tags.name: Settings / Countries
tags.description: Countries a company can run in (Company Settings > Country, Request a Country Change). Only live ones can be picked.

tags.name: Settings / Country Requests
tags.description: Company Settings > Request a Country Change (company: send, withdraw, history) and the Convoy Admin side (approve / decline).

tags.name: Settings / Profiles
tags.description: Profile dialog (account menu): your own picture, display name and mobile. Name and email are set by an Admin in Users.

tags.name: Settings / Public Holidays
tags.description: Public holidays (Calendars > Public Holidays): list by year, add, edit, remove, Add MOM [year] Dates.

tags.name: Settings / Users
tags.description:
Settings > Users: list with status counts, Add User, Edit (permissions, Super Admin, schools), Suspend / Turn back on,
Delete (soft), and the role presets for Start From a Role / View Role Permissions.

tags.name: Client Portal / Portal Passwords
tags.description: Client Portal: Set Password and Sign In, after a correct one-time code (first sign-in or forgotten password).

tags.name: Client Portal / Portal Sessions
tags.description:
Client Portal sign-in. Email first (lookup): a person who has set a password types it; at first sign-in a one-time
code is emailed, then they set their password (verify → PasswordsController). Forgot password = a new code.
One person can be a user of several clients: the session lists them and one is picked (PATCH) for the token.

get.description:
GET /api/v1/session

The account menu's **Profile** dialog. Every signed-in user (Convoy Admin too) edits only their own profile.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Open | `GET /profile` |
| Save Profile | `PATCH /profile` (multipart when a picture is sent) |

```
profile[display_name]   optional; empty = use the name
profile[mobile]         optional; "9123 4567" or "+65 9123 4567", saved as +6591234567
profile[avatar]         image file (JPG, PNG, WebP)
profile[remove_avatar]  true to remove the picture
```

The response (also `data.user` of `GET /session`) has `name`, `email` (read only: "set by an Admin in Users"),
`display_name`, `shown_name` (display name or name: use it in the top bar), `initials`, `mobile`, `mobile_display`,
`avatar { url, thumb_url }`, `role_label` (the line under the title, for example "Planner"). `422` when the mobile is not a
possible phone number.

_Source: `settings.md` § 2. Profile_

`sessions#show`

error.message: Sign in to continue

patch.description:
PATCH /api/v1/session { company_id } — Convoy Admin picks the company to view (for this sign-in).

`POST /session` returns a token (JWT). Send it on **every** other request:

```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...
```

- The token lasts **30 days** (`expires_at`); after that, or after sign-out, calls answer `401` and the app signs in again.
- Each sign-in is its own token (one per device or browser). Signing out ends only that token.
- No cookies are used. Web apps keep the token in memory or `localStorage` (never put user-typed HTML in the page);
  mobile apps keep it in the Keychain / Keystore.
- Cross-origin web front ends must be allowed by the server (`CORS_ORIGINS`; staging accepts any `localhost` port).

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Sign in | `POST /session` `{ "email": "...", "password": "...", "device_name": "iPhone 16" }` (`device_name` optional) |
| Who am I (on page load) | `GET /session` |
| Sign out (this token) | `DELETE /session` → `204` |
| Convoy Admin picks the company to view (for this token) | `PATCH /session` `{ "company_id": 1 }` |

`POST /session` response = the `GET /session` response below plus the token:

```json
{ "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_at": "2026-12-02T09:00:00+08:00",
            "user": { "...": "..." }, "company": { "...": "..." } } }
```

`GET /session` response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "user": { "id": 2, "name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "display_name": null, "shown_name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "email": "ops@simpledrive.sg",
              "mobile": null, "mobile_display": null, "role": "admin", "role_label": "Super Admin", "owner": true,
              "permissions": ["users", "vehicles", "finance", "..."], "initials": "SO", "avatar": null, "status": "active", "company_id": 1 },
```

delete.description:
DELETE /api/v1/session — signs this token out (other devices stay signed in).

`POST /session` returns a token (JWT). Send it on **every** other request:

```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...
```

- The token lasts **30 days** (`expires_at`); after that, or after sign-out, calls answer `401` and the app signs in again.
- Each sign-in is its own token (one per device or browser). Signing out ends only that token.
- No cookies are used. Web apps keep the token in memory or `localStorage` (never put user-typed HTML in the page);
  mobile apps keep it in the Keychain / Keystore.
- Cross-origin web front ends must be allowed by the server (`CORS_ORIGINS`; staging accepts any `localhost` port).

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Sign in | `POST /session` `{ "email": "...", "password": "...", "device_name": "iPhone 16" }` (`device_name` optional) |
| Who am I (on page load) | `GET /session` |
| Sign out (this token) | `DELETE /session` → `204` |
| Convoy Admin picks the company to view (for this token) | `PATCH /session` `{ "company_id": 1 }` |

`POST /session` response = the `GET /session` response below plus the token:

```json
{ "data": { "token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...", "token_type": "Bearer", "expires_at": "2026-12-02T09:00:00+08:00",
            "user": { "...": "..." }, "company": { "...": "..." } } }
```

`GET /session` response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "user": { "id": 2, "name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "display_name": null, "shown_name": "SimpleDrive Ops", "email": "ops@simpledrive.sg",

  }
}
```

post.description:
POST /api/v1/session { email, password, device_name } → the Bearer token (JWT, 30 days) with the user and company.

Endpoints that existed before the Settings menu and now behave differently. Check the screens that use them.

| Endpoint | Before | Now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PATCH /companies/:id` | Admin / Super Admin could save | Needs the `users` permission (`403` otherwise). `company[name]` is ignored for company users. `country` only while `country_locked` is `false`. New: `remove_logo` |
| `GET /companies/:id`, `GET /companies` | Company fields | Also `can_edit`, `country_locked`, `country_set_at`, `country_set_by`, `country_request` |
| `POST`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` on `/calendars`, `/calendars/:id/days`, `/public_holidays` (incl. `import`) | Any company user | Needs the `vehicles` or `finance` permission (`403` otherwise). Reading is unchanged. Change a Day on the Scheduler is affected too |
| `POST /public_holidays` | Added one holiday | A Sunday holiday also adds the Monday after as observed; the response has `meta.observed` (or `null`). Duplicate date message: `Date is already a public holiday` |
| `GET /public_holidays?year=` | `meta: {}` | `meta: { year, count, weekdays, preset_available, preset_missing }` |
| `GET /calendars` | Calendar fields | Also `trips_count` |
| `GET /calendars/:id` | Every day | `?year=` keeps only the days touching that year (no `year` = every day, as before) |
| `POST` / `PATCH /calendars` | | `422` for a duplicate name (any case), the name "Public Holidays", or a changed `kind` |
| `GET /session` (`data.user`) | User fields | Also `display_name`, `shown_name`, `mobile_display`, `role_label`; `initials` come from `shown_name` |
| `POST /session` | | A deleted user cannot sign in |
| Passwords | At least 6 characters | At least 8 characters |

_Source: `settings.md` § 6. Changes to existing endpoints (02/11/2026)_

post.description:
POST /portal/session/lookup { email } → { next: "password" } or { next: "code", purpose: "first" } (code emailed)

| Screen / button | Call | Next |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Work Email → Continue | `POST /portal/session/lookup { email }` | `next: "password"` → Password screen; `next: "code"` → One-Time Code screen (code emailed) |
| Password → Sign In | `POST /portal/session { email, password, device_name }` | Signed in (§ 5.2) |
| Forgot password? Send a code instead | `POST /portal/session/code { email }` | One-Time Code screen (`purpose: "reset"`) |
| One-Time Code → Verify | `POST /portal/session/verify { email, code }` | `{ set_password_token, purpose }` → Set Password screen |
| Set Password and Sign In | `POST /portal/password { set_password_token, password, password_confirmation, device_name }` | Signed in (§ 5.2) |
| Account picker (several clients) | 🔒 `PATCH /portal/session { client_user_id }` | `current` set |
| Page load | 🔒 `GET /portal/session` | Session (§ 5.2) |
| Sign Out | 🔒 `DELETE /portal/session` | `204` |

Lookup / code response: `{ email, next: "code", purpose: "first" | "reset", dev_code? }`.
Texts: first → "First sign-in: we sent a one-time code to your email. Enter it, then set your own password.";
reset → "We sent a one-time code to your email. Enter it to set a new password."

**`dev_code`**: email sending is not set up yet. On staging (and dev with `PORTAL_SHOW_CODE=1`) the response carries the
code: show it like the prototype ("Sample: the code is 123456 until email sending is set up"). Production never sends it.

Errors (`422` unless noted):
- "No client account for this email. Ask your transport company to add you under Managed Clients"
- "That code is not right. Check the email and try again" (5 tries), "That code has expired. Send a new one" (15 minutes, works once)
- "Too many codes asked for. Try again in an hour" (5 codes an hour)
- Set password: `details.password` "Password needs at least 8 characters", `details.password_confirmation` "doesn't match Password";
  "This link has expired. Ask for a new code" (the token works once, for 15 minutes)
- Sign in: `401` "Email or password is incorrect". Too many tries from one IP: `429`.

_Source: `clients.md` § 5.1 The screens_

Also: `locked`, `locked_at`, `locked_by`, `active_users`, `maker_checker_warning` ("Maker-checker is on, but only 1 active

runs", "Maker-checker needs at least two active users. Add another user first", "Maker-checker needs at least two people: add

GET /finance/invoices/summary?month= — KPIs and aging.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| KPIs and Aging card | `GET /finance/invoices/summary?month=2026-11` |
| Clients card (balance by billing entity) | `GET /finance/invoices/clients` |
| Statement (print) | `GET /finance/invoices/statement?client_id=&client_site_id=` |
| Record Payment | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/payments { paid_on, amount, method, reference }` |
| Credit Note | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/credit_note { amount, reason }` |
| Email | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/send { to: [], cc: [] }` (recorded only) |

All three need an issued invoice (`422` "Only an issued invoice can take this") and return the invoice.

- **Payments**: `method` one of `Bank Transfer`, `PayNow`, `GIRO`, `Cheque`, `Cash`; `paid_on` defaults to today, `amount` to the balance on the
  front end. `422` "Enter the amount received", "More than the balance of S$x", "Pick how it was paid".
  Shown as "<paid_on> | <method> <reference>".
- **Credit note**: a document of its own (`kind: credit_note`, `CN-2026-000001`, no GST breakdown) that reduces the invoice's balance.
  `422` "Enter the credit amount", "More than the balance of S$x", "Enter the reason". Listed in the Credit Notes tab and in the invoice's `credit_notes`.
- **Email**: no email is sent yet; `to` / `cc` default to the billing people (To / CC). `422` "Add who the invoice goes To in Billing Details".
  `sends [{ at, to, cc, by }]` → "Emailed to <to> on <date> (recorded)".
- Invoice amounts: `paid`, `credited`, `balance` = total − paid − credit notes (not below 0).

Summary: `{ owed, overdue, invoiced, collected, month, aging [{ key, label, amount, count }] }` — Owed to You (open balances),
Overdue (past due), Invoiced <Mon> (issued that month), Collected <Mon> (payments that month). Aging buckets: `current`
(not past due), `1_30`, `31_60`, `61_90`, `over_90` (days past due).

Clients: `[{ client_id, client_site_id, name, balance, invoices }]`, largest balance first.

Statement: `{ client, client_site_id, date, rows [{ date, type: invoice | payment | credit_note, number, text, charge, credit, balance }],
balance, aging }` — the Statement of Account with a running balance.

_Source: `finance.md` § 3. Client Invoices: payments, credit notes, reports_

post.description:
POST /finance/invoices/:id/payments { paid_on, amount, method, reference }

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| KPIs and Aging card | `GET /finance/invoices/summary?month=2026-11` |
| Clients card (balance by billing entity) | `GET /finance/invoices/clients` |
| Statement (print) | `GET /finance/invoices/statement?client_id=&client_site_id=` |
| Record Payment | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/payments { paid_on, amount, method, reference }` |
| Credit Note | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/credit_note { amount, reason }` |
| Email | `POST /finance/invoices/:id/send { to: [], cc: [] }` (recorded only) |

All three need an issued invoice (`422` "Only an issued invoice can take this") and return the invoice.

- **Payments**: `method` one of `Bank Transfer`, `PayNow`, `GIRO`, `Cheque`, `Cash`; `paid_on` defaults to today, `amount` to the balance on the
  front end. `422` "Enter the amount received", "More than the balance of S$x", "Pick how it was paid".
  Shown as "<paid_on> | <method> <reference>".
- **Credit note**: a document of its own (`kind: credit_note`, `CN-2026-000001`, no GST breakdown) that reduces the invoice's balance.
  `422` "Enter the credit amount", "More than the balance of S$x", "Enter the reason". Listed in the Credit Notes tab and in the invoice's `credit_notes`.
- **Email**: no email is sent yet; `to` / `cc` default to the billing people (To / CC). `422` "Add who the invoice goes To in Billing Details".
  `sends [{ at, to, cc, by }]` → "Emailed to <to> on <date> (recorded)".
- Invoice amounts: `paid`, `credited`, `balance` = total − paid − credit notes (not below 0).

Summary: `{ owed, overdue, invoiced, collected, month, aging [{ key, label, amount, count }] }` — Owed to You (open balances),
Overdue (past due), Invoiced <Mon> (issued that month), Collected <Mon> (payments that month). Aging buckets: `current`
(not past due), `1_30`, `31_60`, `61_90`, `over_90` (days past due).

Clients: `[{ client_id, client_site_id, name, balance, invoices }]`, largest balance first.

Statement: `{ client, client_site_id, date, rows [{ date, type: invoice | payment | credit_note, number, text, charge, credit, balance }],
balance, aging }` — the Statement of Account with a running balance.

_Source: `finance.md` § 3. Client Invoices: payments, credit notes, reports_

get.description:
GET /finance/operator_pay/requests

Everything the company owes operators. Finance approves requests and sets the pay date; approvals with the same pay date
pool into one batch, which makes one bank file and one payment notice per operator. Approving, changing pay dates and
recording payments need an approver of Finance Settings (`422` "Only approvers in Finance Settings can approve requests,
set pay dates and record payments"); when no approver is set, anyone with `finance` can.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Payment Requests tab, KPIs | `GET /finance/operator_pay/requests` |
| Set a run's cost | `PUT /finance/operator_pay/costs { ref, amount }` (`422` "Enter a cost of 0 or more") |
| Add Item for <operator> | `POST /finance/operator_pay/items { operator_id, sign: pay \| deduct, description, item_on, amount }` |
| Delete an item | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/items/:id` |
| Approve and Set Pay Date | `POST /finance/operator_pay/approve { refs: [], pay_date }` or `{ refs: [], batch_id }` (Or add to an open batch) |
| Ad Hoc Payment / Pay Now | `POST /finance/operator_pay/ad_hoc { operator_id, pay_date, refs: [], extra: { description, amount } }` |
| Batches tab | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches` |
| A batch | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Change Pay Date (pool into another batch) | `PATCH /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id { pay_date, merge: true }` |
| Cancel Batch | `DELETE /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id` |
| Pay (one operator) | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/payments { batch_operator_id, paid_on, amount, method, reference }` |
| Mark All Paid | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/mark_paid` |
| Make Bank File | `POST /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file { transfer_type: FAST \| GIRO }` → the batch + `csv`, `filename` |
| Download Again | `GET /finance/operator_pay/batches/:id/bank_file.csv` (CSV file) |

_Source: `finance.md` § 4. Operator Payments_

GET /finance/vehicles/pl?period=month|ytd|this_year|last_year|last_12|all&basis=profit|cash&month=2026-10

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Period, basis, fleet totals, profit by vehicle, categories, 12-month chart, cost per km by bus size | `GET /finance/vehicles/pl?period=&basis=&month=2026-10` |
| A vehicle's P&L, break-even, manual entries | `GET /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/pl?period=&basis=&month=` |
| Cost Spikes / Mark Checked | `GET /finance/vehicles/spikes?month=`, `POST /finance/vehicles/spikes/ack { vehicle_id, category, month: "2026-10" }` |
| Due in the next 90 days | `GET /finance/vehicles/due` |
| Add a manual revenue / cost | `POST /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/entries { entry: { kind, category, entry_on, amount, repeats_monthly, note } }` |
| Stop a repeat from a month / edit | `PATCH /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/entries/:id { entry: { repeat_until: "2026-12-31" } }` |
| Delete an entry (repeating: "Delete <cat> from every month it repeats in?") | `DELETE /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/entries/:id` |

`period`: `month` (the `month` given), `ytd` (Year to Date), `this_year`, `last_year`, `last_12` (Last 12 Months), `all` (All Time).
`basis`: `profit` (depreciation and loan interest) or `cash` (purchase / down payment and loan instalments when paid out).

Fleet: `{ period, basis, from, to, revenue, cost, profit, margin, vehicles [{ vehicle_id, plate, seats, revenue, cost, profit }] (weakest first),
categories [{ kind, category, amount }], chart [{ month, revenue, cost, profit }] (12 months to `month`),
cost_per_km [{ size: Minibus | Medium Bus | Coach, vehicles, km, cost_per_km, revenue_per_km, profit_per_km }] }`.
Vehicle: the same totals, `categories`, `chart`, `break_even { revenue, cost, trip_revenue, runs, per_run, runs_needed, gap }`
("Short by" when `gap` > 0, else "Covered by") and `entries`.

What is counted (each month):

| Category | Kind | From |
| --- | --- | --- |
| "<Trip kind> (auto)", e.g. "Ad Hoc / Charter (auto)", "Shuttle (auto)" | revenue | Client price of runs on the bus, not cancelled, up to today |
| Manual entries | revenue / cost | Once in the month of `entry_on`, or every month from it until `repeat_until` |
| "Insurance Premium (auto)" | cost | Each policy's premium (before GST) spread over its cover months |
| "Fuel and Energy (auto)" | cost | Fuel & Energy entries |
| "Maintenance (auto)" | cost | Completed maintenance visits (with GST) |
| "Driver Salary (auto)", "Employer CPF (auto)" | cost | Each default driver's pay scheme for the month with no trips (fixed pay and top-up), × the share of the month they were the bus's default driver; CPF for Citizens / PR by age band (KYC) |
| "Depreciation" (profit) | cost | Purchase price over the months to COE expiry (else 120 months) from the buying month |
| "Loan Interest" (profit) | cost | Interest of each instalment in its due month |
| "Purchase" / "Down Payment", "Loan Instalments" (cash) | cost | In the buying month / each instalment's due month |

Manual categories: revenue `School Bus`, `Charter and Trips`, `Contract`, `Other Revenue`; cost `Road Tax`, `Parking and ERP`,
`Cleaning`, `Other Cost`. `422`: "Enter an amount above zero", "Pick the date", "Category is not a <kind> category".
The "Is This Already Counted?" question before adding revenue is front end only.

Cost spike: `{ vehicle_id, plate, category, amount, usual, month, checked }` — a cost this month above 1.5 × its median of the six
months before (present in at least three) and S$100 over it.

Due: `[{ vehicle_id, plate, date, kind: instalment | insurance | road_tax | coe, text, amount }]` — unpaid instalments (also overdue),
insurance renewals (last premium total), road tax expiry (estimated from the Road Tax entries), COE expiry.

_Source: `finance.md` § 7. Vehicle Financials: profit and loss_

| Tick instalments paid / unpaid | `POST /finance/vehicles/:vehicle_id/instalments { numbers: [1, 2], paid: true, paid_on }` |
| Financials on the vehicle record | `financials` of `GET /vehicles/:id` (users with `vehfin`) |

Row: `{ vehicle_id, plate, make, model, status, funding, lender, purchase_price, owed, monthly, due_this_month }`;
`meta { purchase_cost, owed, monthly, due_this_month }` (Fleet Purchase Cost, Still Owed on Loans, Monthly Instalments, Due This Month).
`status`: `no_details` (No Details), `paid_in_full`, `incomplete` (loan terms missing), `overdue`, `loan_paid_off`, `loan_active`.

Vehicle adds `financial` (the form fields + `schedule_file { url, name }`), `schedule` and `rows`:

- Form fields: `funding` (`loan` / `cash` = Paid in Full), `purchase_price`, `down_payment` (empty = price − loan), `bought_on`, `lender`,
  `account_number`, `loan_amount`, `rate` (% a year), `tenure_months`, `term_charge`, `first_due_on`, `first_instalment`,
  `monthly_instalment`, `last_instalment` (empty = worked out). A loan needs Loan Amount, Tenure and First Instalment Due.
- `schedule`: `{ loan, rate, tenure, term_charge, term_charge_auto, total, scheduled, first, monthly, monthly_auto, last, last_auto, down,
  valid, paid_count, paid_amount, owed, principal_owed, interest_paid, interest_owed, next_due, overdue_count, ends_on, check }`.
  Auto values: term charge = loan × rate × tenure / 12 (flat rate); monthly = (loan + term charge) / tenure rounded up; last = the rest.
  `check` = "The instalments add up to S$x, but loan plus term charge is S$y. Check the figures against the schedule" (or `null`).
- `rows`: `[{ n, due_on, amount, interest, principal, balance, paid_on, status: paid | overdue | due | upcoming }]` (interest spread evenly).
- Reading a schedule fills only empty fields and marks the instalments it shows as paid. A schedule for another plate:
  `422` "This schedule is for PD1234A, not PC7475L. Use Anyway or Remove File first" → resend with `use_anyway: true`.

Vehicle record `financials`: `{ status, funding, purchase_price, bought_on, lender, loan_amount, monthly, owed, ends_on }`, `{ status: "no_details" }`,
or `null` for users without `vehfin` and operator buses.

get.description:
GET /pay/earnings?month=2026-10&q=

What each driver earned in a month from the trips on the Scheduler. A run counts once it has run and no issue is raised
on it; cancelled, skipped and upcoming runs earn nothing.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Month select, Search, the driver list and totals | `GET /pay/earnings?month=2026-10&q=` |
| Open a driver | `GET /pay/earnings/:driver_id?month=2026-10` |
| Raise an Issue / Clear Issue on a run | `POST /occurrences/:id/issue { reason }` / `DELETE /occurrences/:id/issue` ([scheduler](scheduler.md)), then reload |
| Confirm Month (confirm text in the prototype) | `POST /pay/earnings/:driver_id/confirm?month=2026-10` |
| Reopen Month (Admin; confirm "Reopen <Month> for <driver>?") | `DELETE /pay/earnings/:driver_id/confirm?month=2026-10` |
| Click a Trip ID | Scheduler day view of that run (`date`, run `id`) |

List row: `{ driver_id, name, month, total, completed, held, vehicle { id, plate }, status, confirmed }`;
`meta { month, completed, held, total, confirmed, drivers }` ("<confirmed> of <drivers> confirmed").
`status`: `confirmed` (badge Confirmed), `held` (a run has an issue: Held), `to_confirm` (month ended: To Confirm), `open` (Open).
`confirmed`: `{ by, at, total }` or `null`. A confirmed month shows the frozen `total`.

Driver (`GET /pay/earnings/:driver_id`, and the answer of Confirm / Reopen) adds:

| Field | |
| --- | --- |
| `schemes` | `[{ from, to, id, name, rate_plan }]` — "<scheme> \| <rate plan>" (two when the scheme changed mid-month) |
| `counts` | `{ completed, issue, cancelled, upcoming, running }` (KPIs) |
| `can_confirm`, `why` | `why`: "The month can be confirmed from 1 Dec 2026", "No pay scheme assigned. Pick one in Drivers", "1 trip has an issue raised. Clear them first" |
| `breakdown` | Per part of the month: `{ from, to, scheme, rows, amounts, weeks }` (same rows as the simulator; a confirmed month: the frozen rows) |
| `runs` | `[{ id, date, start_time, end_time, trip_id, trip_label, kind, plate, trip_value, hours, status, issue { reason, at }, amount }]` |

Run `status`: `completed` (Completed), `issue` (Issue Raised: pay held), `running`, `upcoming`, `cancelled`. `amount` = what the
run earned (completed runs only). `hours` is set for runs paid by the hour (disposal, or trips priced by the hour), to the
quarter hour (rounded as the trip says: up by default); others show `trip_value`.

Confirm `422`: the `why` texts, "<Month> is already confirmed". Once a month is confirmed, raising or clearing an issue on
its runs answers `422` "Driver pay for October 2026 is confirmed. Reopen it in HR, Earnings first".

**Export Statement** is printed by the front end from this data (header "Earnings Statement", the breakdown, the runs;
"Provisional, not yet confirmed" until confirmed).

_Source: `hr.md` § 5. Earnings_

| Save Current Month / Save Over | `PUT /pay/simulator_templates/:slot { template: {...} }` |

get.description:
GET /pay/audit_log?q=&action_type=&item=&page=

`GET /pay/audit_log?q=&action_type=&item=&page=` — every change to rate plans, pay schemes, bonuses, rewards, driver
assignments, points and confirmed months, newest first (the latest 500 changes). Entries can't be edited.

```json
{ "data": [ { "id": 62, "at": "2026-11-02T09:00:00+08:00", "user": "Olivia Owner", "action": "award", "item": "points",
              "item_label": "Points", "name": "Eric Pang", "details": "Awarded 20 points: Good conduct" } ],
  "meta": { "page": 1, "limit": 50, "count": 6, "pages": 1,
            "actions": ["create", "update", "delete", "lock", "unlock", "award", "deduct", "confirm", "reopen"],
            "items": { "rate_plan": "Rate Plan", "pay_scheme": "Pay Scheme", "campaign_bonus": "Bonus", "reward": "Reward",
                       "driver_assignment": "Driver", "driver_pay": "Driver Pay", "points": "Points" } } }
```

- Filters: `q` (user, name or details), `action_type` (one of `meta.actions`; labels Created, Updated, Deleted, Locked, Unlocked,
  Awarded, Deducted, Confirmed, Reopened), `item` (a key of `meta.items`).
- Columns: When (`at`, local date and HH:MM) | Who | Action (chip) | Item (`item_label` + `name`) | Details.

_Source: `hr.md` § 8. Audit Log_

```json
{ "driver": { "id": 4, "name": "Eric Pang" }, "balance": 230, "earned": 350, "used": 120, "expired": 0, "expiring_soon": 0,
  "history": [ { "kind": "deduct", "id": 2, "points": -120, "reason": "S$10 Grab voucher", "on": "2026-11-02", "by": "SimpleDrive Ops", "status": "used" },

                 "on": "2026-11-02", "expires_on": "2028-11-02", "by": "SimpleDrive Ops", "status": "active" } ] }
```

- Points are kept as lots: each award lasts 24 months; a deduction takes points from the lots expiring first, so an expired
  lot only loses what was left of it. `status` of an award: `active`, `used` (nothing left), `expired` (some left and expired).
- Texts: "{expiring_soon} points expire in the next 60 days"; "Awarded points expire after 24 months"; "Deducted points come off
  the balance now, up to {balance}". `source: "bonus"` = points of a bonus paid in a confirmed month ("Bonus: <name>, Oct 2026").
- `422`: "Enter the number of points", "Enter a reason", "Eric Pang has only 30 points".

get.description:
Own drivers (active), with the pay scheme and vehicle type used to work out their pay. Operator drivers are paid by
their operator and are not listed.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| List, Search (name) | `GET /pay/drivers?q=` |
| Open a driver | `GET /pay/drivers/:id` |
| Assign Scheme | `POST /pay/drivers/:id/schemes { assignment: { pay_scheme_id, starts_on, ends_on } }` |
| Change a scheme row (scheme, start, end) | `PATCH /pay/drivers/:id/schemes/:assignment_id { assignment: {...} }` |
| Remove a scheme row (confirm "Remove this assignment?") | `DELETE /pay/drivers/:id/schemes/:assignment_id` |
| Assign Vehicle Type / change / remove | Same on `/pay/drivers/:id/vehicle_types` with `vehicle_type_id` |

Row: `{ id, name, phone, photo, age, vehicle { id, plate }, vehicle_type { id, name }, scheme_today { id, name } | null, warning }`.
Sub line: "<plate | No vehicle> | <scheme_today.name | No pay scheme>"; "Age <age>" (from the driver's KYC, `null` when not shared).
Each change saves at once and returns the driver.

Driver (`GET /pay/drivers/:id` and every change) adds:
- `pay_schemes [{ id, pay_scheme { id, name }, starts_on, ends_on, tag }]`, `tag` = `upcoming` / `current` / `ended`.
- `vehicle_types [{ id, vehicle_type { id, name }, starts_on, ends_on, tag, warning }]`.
- `min_start` (start dates can go back up to 1 month: "Start dates can go back up to 1 month, to <date>").
- `default_scheme { id, name }`: no scheme rows → "No scheme assigned yet, so <name> is paid on the default scheme, <default>".

Rules: rows never overlap — a new row ends the one before it on the day before (`ends_on` is set for you). A driver with
scheme rows that don't cover a date has **no scheme** that day (paid S$0 → "No pay scheme today"). Without vehicle type
rows, each job is paid at the type of its bus (by seats). `warning`: "Rate plan <plan> of <scheme> has no rates for <type>,
so these jobs are paid S$0". `422`: `details.starts_on` "Starts on can go back up to 1 month, to 2 Oct 2026",
"Starts on already has an assignment"; `details.ends_on` "Ends on is before the start date".

_Source: `hr.md` § 3. Drivers_

GET /api/v1/profile

The account menu's **Profile** dialog. Every signed-in user (Convoy Admin too) edits only their own profile.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Open | `GET /profile` |
| Save Profile | `PATCH /profile` (multipart when a picture is sent) |

```
profile[display_name]   optional; empty = use the name
profile[mobile]         optional; "9123 4567" or "+65 9123 4567", saved as +6591234567
profile[avatar]         image file (JPG, PNG, WebP)
profile[remove_avatar]  true to remove the picture
```

The response (also `data.user` of `GET /session`) has `name`, `email` (read only: "set by an Admin in Users"),
`display_name`, `shown_name` (display name or name: use it in the top bar), `initials`, `mobile`, `mobile_display`,

Add: `POST /users`. Edit: `PATCH /users/:id`.

```json
{ "user": { "name": "Paula Planner", "email": "paula@example.com", "password": "secret123",
            "permissions": ["schools", "plans", "planview"], "owner": false,
            "all_schools": false, "school_ids": [12] } }
```

- `name`, `email`, `password` (at least 8 characters) only when adding. On edit they are ignored: the name and email are
  set when the user is added.
- `permissions`: every permission (or `owner: true`) makes the user an Admin: all permissions, every school.
- `all_schools: true` = every school, including new ones. `false` = only `school_ids` (may be empty: the user opens no school).
  Leave both out on edit to keep the schools as they are.
- Response: the row (§ 1.2), `201` when added.
- `422` messages: `Email is already used by another user`, `Password is too short (minimum is 8 characters)`,
  `Only a Super Admin can make a Super Admin`, `Only a Super Admin can change a Super Admin`,
  `You can't remove your own Users permission`, `There must always be at least one active Super Admin`.

post.description:
POST /public_holidays/import { year } — adds the gazetted dates not on the list yet.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Calendar list | `GET /calendars` |
| One calendar with its days | `GET /calendars/:id` |
| Add a day (Change a Day / Add a Day) | `POST /calendars/:calendar_id/days` `{ "calendar_day": { kind, starts_on, ends_on, label, usual_time, new_time, shift_minutes, in_place_of, notify_drivers } }` |
| Edit / remove a day | `PATCH` / `DELETE /calendars/:calendar_id/days/:id` |
| New calendar | `POST /calendars` `{ "calendar": { name, kind: "school" | "general", observed_holidays, morning_time, afternoon_time }, "start_from": "moe" | "blank" | "<calendar id>" }` |
| Edit / delete calendar | `PATCH` / `DELETE /calendars/:id` (a calendar used by trips can't be deleted) |
| Public holidays | `GET /public_holidays?year=2027`, `POST /public_holidays` `{ public_holiday: { date, name, observed } }`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, Add MOM [year] Dates: `POST /public_holidays/import` `{ year }` |

Day `kind`: school calendars `hol` School Holiday, `ns` No School, `early` Early Dismissal, `late` Late Arrival
(`usual_time` + `new_time`); general calendars `off` Day Off, `shift` Changed Times (`shift_minutes` ±), `oil` Off in Lieu
(`in_place_of`), `work` Working Holiday. Runs re-sync in the background after a change: reload the grid after a few seconds.
Changing calendars needs the `vehicles` or `finance` permission. The full Calendars page (year view, trips using a calendar,
observed Monday for a Sunday holiday) is in [settings.md § 4](settings.md#4-calendars).

---

_Source: `scheduler.md` § 10. Change a Day (calendars)_

get.description:
GET /client_users/roles

People at the client who sign in to the Client Portal. The same email can be a user of several clients (one Portal
account, an account picker at sign-in).

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| List | `GET /clients/:client_id/users` |
| Add User | `POST /clients/:client_id/users { client_user: { name, title, email, role, site_ids: [] } }` |
| Edit (dialog: title, role, site access) | `PATCH /clients/:client_id/users/:id { client_user: { title, role, site_ids: [] } }` |
| Remove | `DELETE /clients/:client_id/users/:id` (confirm "Remove <name>?") |
| Role select, Role Permissions window | `GET /client_users/roles` |

User: `{ id, client_id, name, title, email, role, role_label, wide, sites [{ id, name }], created_by { id, name }, created_at,
portal { password_set, last_sign_in_at } }`. Sub line: "Added <created_at> by <created_by.name>"; sites text: `wide` or no
sites → "All sites", else the site names. The list's Users column: `users_count` on `GET /clients`.

- **Site Access**: `wide` roles (Super Admin, Admin, Finance Admin) cover every site: hide the pills, `site_ids` is ignored.
  Site roles need at least one site when the client has sites (`422` "Pick at least one site for a Site Admin").
  Hint: no sites → "This client has no sites, so access covers everything".
- On edit, leave `site_ids` out to keep the sites. Name and email are not changed after adding.
- `422`: "Email is already a user of this client", "<email> belongs to a Convoy OS user of your company",
  "Keep at least one Super Admin for <client>" (changing or removing the last one), "Some sites are not sites of <client>".
- After adding: "They sign in to the Client Portal with this email, get a one-time code the first time and set their own password."

_Source: `clients.md` § 3. Client Users_

`client_users#roles`

billing_contacts [{ id, name, email, send_as, attention }], shuttle_trips_count, created_at }`.

sub line "On 2 shuttle trips" (`shuttle_trips_count`), else "Pin set" / "No pin".

Edit Site body:

```json
{ "client_site": { "school_id": 4, "own_billing": true, "billing_name": "Bright Steps (Punggol) Pte Ltd",
                   "billing_uen": "201912345K", "billing_address": "1 Punggol Field",
                   "billing_contacts": [ { "name": "Accounts", "email": "ap@bs.sg", "send_as": "to", "attention": false },
```

Add: `POST /clients`. Edit: `PATCH /clients/:id`.

```json
{ "client": { "kind": "company", "name": "St. Stephen's School", "uen": "T08GB0047K", "contact_name": "Mrs Lee",
              "billing_address": "20 Siglap View", "phone": "+65 6241 1243", "email": "transport@ststephens.edu.sg",
              "school_id": 3, "school_calendar_id": 7 } }
```

- `kind`: `company`, `individual` (name label "Full Name"; no UEN / contact), `transport_company` (Main Contractor).
- `uen` is upper-cased; `422` "Uen looks wrong. Examples: 53012345A, 201912345K, T09LL1234A".
- An individual needs a phone or an email.
- **This Client Is a School** (only `company`, shown when School Bus has schools): `school_id` links the school to this client
  (`null` / empty unlinks it). `422` "<school> is already linked to <client>".
- **School Calendar** (only with a school): `school_calendar_id`, a calendar with `kind: school` (`422` "Pick a school calendar").
  It is the school's calendar: its holidays stop the school's buses (they re-sync in the background).
- Changing `kind` away from `company` unlinks the school.
- Response: the record (§ 1.3), `201` when added.

_Source: `clients.md` § 1.2 Add / Edit Details_

put.description:
PUT /vehicle_teams/bulk { teams: [{ id?, name, color }] } — the whole Manage Teams window at once.

The whole window is saved at once:

```json
{ "teams": [ { "id": 1, "name": "East Depot", "color": "#004F59" }, { "name": "Coaches", "color": "#1E5631" } ] }
```

- A row with `id` renames or recolours that team; its vehicles move with it. A row without `id` adds a team.
- A team left out is deleted and its vehicles are left with no team. Ask first: "Delete East? Its 6 vehicles are left with no team".
- Two teams may swap names in one save.
- Errors (422): `"Give every team a name"`, `"Two teams have the same name"`.
- Response: the teams `[{ id, name, color }]`.

Colour swatches (front end): Teal `#004F59`, Sky `#2F7FA8`, Navy `#1F3A68`, Plum `#5B2A6E`, Rose `#B0306A`, Maroon `#8A1C2B`,
Amber `#B35C00`, Olive `#8C6D1F`, Forest `#1E5631`, Graphite `#33373D`.

post.description:
`POST /operators` / `PATCH /operators/:id`:

```json
{ "operator": { "name": "Hup Seng Coaches", "kind": "managed", "uen": "199801234D", "contact_name": "Mr Lim",
                "phone": "+65 6123 4567", "email": "ops@hupseng.sg",
                "payment_method": "bank", "paynow_uen": "199801234D",
                "bank_id": 1, "account_number": "0721234567", "account_name": "HUP SENG COACHES PTE LTD", "branch_code": null } }
```

- `payment_method` is the default: `paynow` (PayNow UEN card) or `bank` (Bank Transfer card). Both can be saved.
- PayNow UEN left empty uses the UEN. UENs are checked: `"Uen looks wrong. Examples: 53012345A, 201912345K, T09LL1234A"`.
- Bank details (when `payment_method` is `bank` or any bank field is given): bank, 6 to 14 digit account number, account name.
- The branch code is worked out from the account number; send `branch_code` only for banks with `pick_branch` / `enter_branch`
  (3.3). Errors: `details.branch_code: ["Branch code must be picked"]`, `["Branch code must be 3 digits"]`,
  `details.account_number: ["Account number matches no UOB branch (check the first 3 digits)"]`.
- Changing the bank clears the old branch code.
- External operators: `paynow_uen` (free text), `cost_per_trip`, `cost_per_day`, `valid_until`; no payment checks.

Delete: `DELETE /operators/:id`. Refused while it has buses: `"Remove the 2 vehicles of Hup Seng Coaches first"`.
Ask first when `routes_count > 0`: "Hup Seng runs 3 routes. Delete anyway?".

_Source: `fleet.md` § 3.2 Add / Edit_

GET /banks/:id/branch?account_number=&branch_code= → { code, name, send, note, error, rule }

`GET /banks` (no paging, platform list):

```json
{ "data": [ { "id": 1, "key": "7171D", "code": "7171", "name": "DBS Bank Ltd", "short_name": "DBS",

              "rule_text": "Branch code is the first 3 digits of the account number",
```

delete.description:
Cancel invite (pending) / Delete (declined, past). Active drivers are removed first.

All are `PATCH /drivers/:id/<action>` (or `/operator_drivers/:id/<action>`) and return the driver.

| Tab | Button | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Pending | Resend | `resend` |
| Pending | Mark Accepted / Mark Declined | `accept` / `decline` (until the Driver app answers, an admin records it) |
| Pending | Cancel invite | `DELETE /drivers/:id` |
| Active | View Details | 2.4 |
| Active | Assign Bus / Swap Bus (operator drivers) | Section 1.5 |
| Active | Remove driver | `remove` → Past Drivers |
| Declined, Past | Invite Again | `reinvite` (back to Pending, invite recorded again) |
| Declined, Past | Delete | `DELETE /drivers/:id` |

- **Remove** (own driver): the bus they drive today has no default driver from today, and any change that would have made them
  a default driver later is cleared too. Their bus is kept as `last_vehicle`. Confirm first: "Remove Tan? They lose access to your
  company in the Convoy Driver app and move to Past Drivers. PD1A will have no driver".
- **Remove** (operator driver): they leave their bus (`last_vehicle` keeps it).
- **Delete** keeps the record for history (runs they drove still show their name) but it leaves every list; the mobile can be
  invited again. Active drivers: 422 `"Remove Tan first. Active drivers move to Past Drivers"`.
- A button not allowed in the current state: 422 `"Tan is past, so this can't be done"`.

get.description:
GET /fuel_entries/vehicles?month= — a card per own vehicle (month cost, efficiency, cost per km, last entry).

One card per own bus:

```json
{ "vehicle_id": 7, "plate": "PD997M", "sub": "Toyota HiAce Commuter", "entries": 23, "month_cost": "1029.91",
  "fuel_efficiency": "9.0", "elec_efficiency": null, "cost_per_km": "0.31", "km": 9623,
  "last": { "date": "2026-11-18", "kind": "diesel", "kind_name": "Diesel", "quantity": "38.5", "unit": "L", "odometer": 49623 } }
```

Efficiency: `fuel_efficiency` km/L or `elec_efficiency` kWh/100km ("No measure yet" when both null); cost per km over the
bus's whole log; "Last <date> | <kind_name>" or "No entries". Clicking a card sets `vehicle_id` on the log.

_Source: `fleet.md` § 8.4 Vehicle cards: `GET /fuel_entries/vehicles?month=2026-11`_

`fuel_entries#vehicles`

GET /fuel_entries?month=2026-11&kind=all|fuel|elec|def&vehicle_id= — the month's log, newest first.

| Param | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `month` | `YYYY-MM` (default this month). `meta.next_month: false` disables the › button |
| `kind` | `all` (default), `fuel` (diesel and petrol), `elec`, `def` |
| `vehicle_id` | One bus (also set by clicking its card) |

All entries of the month, newest first (no paging):

```json
{ "id": 41, "vehicle_id": 7, "plate": "PD997M", "date": "2026-11-09", "time": "07:42", "kind": "diesel", "kind_name": "Diesel",
  "unit": "L", "quantity": "45.2", "cost": "119.78", "unit_price": "2.65", "odometer": 10600, "full": true,
  "fuel_company_id": 1, "fuel_company_name": "Esso", "station": "Jurong West Ave 2", "note": null,
  "km_since": 400, "efficiency": "10.0", "odometer_back": null,
  "driver_id": 3, "driver_name": "Eric Pang", "created_by": "Ops Admin", "document_read_id": null,
  "receipt": { "url": "/api/v1/downloads/...", "name": "receipt.jpg", "size": 81234, "content_type": "image/jpeg" } }
```

Row text:
- Quantity `45.2 L` with `unit_price` per unit ("S$2.65/L"); Odometer with "+400 km" (`km_since`).
- Efficiency: `efficiency` + " km/L" (fuel) or " kWh/100km" (elec); none: AdBlue = empty, `full` = "First full fill",
  else "Partial fill". Full / Partial label from `full`.
- `odometer_back` set: the reading is lower than the one before (shown in orange, and in Needs a Look).
- Station: "<fuel_company_name> <station> | <note>"; By: "<driver_name> | By <created_by>". Receipt button when `receipt`.

How the server works out the numbers (for the How It Works text): efficiency is measured from one full fill to the next of
the same energy: km between the two readings divided by everything added since (partial fills in between included).
`driver_id` is the bus's default driver that day and follows changes to the default driver schedule.

_Source: `fleet.md` § 8.1 The month's log: `GET /fuel_entries?month=2026-11`_

post.description:
POST { fuel_entry: {...}, receipt (file) | document_read_id } → meta { filled, warnings }

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Blank form | `GET /fuel_entries/new?vehicle_id=` → `{ vehicle_id, date, time, kind (of the bus's last entry), full, last_odometer }` |
| Add Entry | `POST /fuel_entries` |
| Save Entry | `PATCH /fuel_entries/:id` |
| Delete | `DELETE /fuel_entries/:id`. Confirm "Delete this diesel entry of 9 Nov?" |

```json
{ "fuel_entry": { "vehicle_id": 7, "date": "2026-11-09", "time": "07:42", "kind": "diesel", "quantity": 45.2, "cost": 119.78,
                  "odometer": 10600, "full": true, "fuel_company_id": 1, "station": "Jurong West Ave 2", "note": "Card 4471" },
  "document_read_id": 88 }
```

- Receipt: multipart `receipt` (PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP), or `document_read_id` of a finished `fuel_receipt` read (8.3).
- `kind`: `diesel`, `petrol`, `def` (AdBlue), `elec`. AdBlue is never a full fill (`full` saved false).
- Odometer hint: "+N km since the last entry (last_odometer km)", orange when lower.
- 422: `vehicle` ("must be one of your own buses"), `date`, `quantity` (> 0), `cost` (≥ 0).
- Response `meta: { filled: ["kind", "date", "quantity", "cost", "station", "fuel_company", "vehicle"], warnings: [...] }`:
  "Receipt read: … Check each one before saving". Warnings: "The receipt shows PD777Z, but the vehicle picked is PD1A",
  "The company on the receipt, Cnergy, is not in the list. Add it in Fuel Companies",
  "The odometer is lower than the last reading of 10650 km. Check the number".

_Source: `fleet.md` § 8.2 Add / Edit / Delete an entry_

```json
{ "id": 9, "vehicle_id": 7, "plate": "PD997M", "fuel_entry_id": 412, "kind": "dbl", "tone": "warn", "metric": "fuel",
  "message": "Two fills 30 km apart (50 L, then 20 L)", "date": "2026-11-10", "status": "open",
  "checked_by": null, "checked_at": null,
  "entry": { "kind_name": "Diesel", "quantity": "20.0", "unit": "L", "time": "10:00", "driver_name": "Eric Pang", "place": "Esso Jurong West Ave 2" } }
```

Row: "<plate> | <date> <entry.time>" over `message` and `entry.place`; checked rows add "Checked by <checked_by> on <checked_at>".
`metric` → Usage measure: `eff` → `eff`, `elec` → `elec`, `fuel` → `fuel`, `km` → `km`, `spend` → `spend`.
`tone: info` (grey) is a better-than-usual efficiency ("A fill may not have been recorded").

What is checked (fills of the last 90 days; the list is refreshed after every save and daily):

| `kind` | Finding |
| --- | --- |
| `eff` | Efficiency more than 30% off the bus's usual (median of 3+ measures) |
| `odo` | Odometer lower than the reading before |
| `dbl` | Two fills of the same energy less than 60 km or 6 hours apart |
| `big` | A fill more than 1.6 × the bus's usual fill (4+ fills) |
| `price` | Price per unit more than 15% above the fleet's usual for that kind |
| `trend` | Fuel (or energy) per km in the last 30 days more than 18% above the 30 days before |

get.description:
GET /fuel/kpis?month=2026-11&vehicle_id=

```json
{ "data": { "month": "2026-11", "spend": "18098.98", "spend_before": "17234.87", "spend_change_pct": 5,
            "fuel_litres": "6435.9", "kwh": "772.46", "fills": 75,
            "fuel_efficiency": "7.5", "elec_efficiency": "22.0", "measured": 84,
            "km": 40667, "cost_per_km": "0.45", "needs_a_look": 5 } }
```

| Tile | Fields |
| --- | --- |
| Spend <month> | `spend`; "+5% vs Oct 2026" from `spend_change_pct` (null: "No entries in <month before>") |
| Fuel | `fuel_litres` L; under it "<kwh> kWh charged" when kWh > 0, else "<fills> fills" |
| Efficiency | `fuel_efficiency` km/L, else `elec_efficiency` kWh/100km, else "N/A"; "Measured over <measured> full fills" or "Needs two full fills with odometer readings" |
| Cost per km | `cost_per_km` and "<km> km driven", or "N/A" / "Enter the odometer at each fill" |
| Needs a Look | `needs_a_look` (orange when > 0): "Unusual fills in the last 90 days" / "Nothing unusual" |

_Source: `fleet.md` § 8.7 KPI row: `GET /fuel/kpis?month=2026-11&vehicle_id=`_

`fuel#kpis`

GET /fuel/usage?view=&key=&measure=&range=&zoom_from=&zoom_to= (see FuelUsage)

| Param | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `view` | `all` (default), `vehicle`, `driver`, `company` (By Vehicle / By Driver / By Company) |
| `key` | With a view: the vehicle, driver or fuel company id picked from the breakdown; `none` = no driver / company set |
| `measure` | `spend` (default), `fuel` (L), `elec` (kWh), `def` (AdBlue L), `km`, `eff` (km/L), `cpk` (cost per km) |
| `range` | `30d` (by day), `12w` (by week, from Monday), `12m` (default, by month) |
| `zoom_from`, `zoom_to` | Clicking a week or month bar: its first and last day (by day). "Back to 12 Months" drops them |

```json
{ "data": {
    "view": "vehicle", "key": null, "measure": "eff", "range": "12m", "zoomed": false, "by": "month",
    "period": { "from": "2025-12-01", "to": "2026-11-20" }, "before": { "from": "2024-12-01", "to": "2025-11-30" },
    "buckets": [ { "from": "2025-12-01", "current": null, "before": null }, { "from": "2026-11-01", "current": "8.2", "before": "8.4" } ],
    "total": "8.2", "total_before": "8.4", "change_pct": -2, "better": "higher",
    "rows": [ { "key": "7", "name": "PD997M", "current": "8.2", "before": "8.4", "change_pct": -2, "alerts": 2 } ],
    "drivers": [],
    "summary": { "title": "Worth a Look", "worth_a_look": true,
                 "text": "Spend is S$3975.00, up 12% on the period before. Fuel use is 8.2 km/L, steady against 8.4 before. 2 fills need a look, ..." } } }
```

- Chart: `spend`, `fuel`, `elec`, `def`, `km` as bars (this period beside the period before); `eff` and `cpk` as lines.
  `current` / `before` null = nothing measured in that bucket (gap in the line). The last bucket is the period so far.
- Totals: "<period> <total>", "<before label> <total_before>", change `change_pct`% coloured by `better`
  (`higher`: up is green; `lower`: down is green; null: neutral).
- The period before: 30 days / 12 weeks / 12 months earlier; a zoomed month against the month before; a zoomed week against
  the week before.
- `rows` (views other than all): every vehicle / driver / company with entries in either period, biggest first; `alerts` =
  open Needs a Look on it ("2 to check"). Clicking a row sets `key`.
- `drivers` (By Driver): `[{ driver_id, name, excess_pct, excess_pct_before, km, vehicles: ["PD1A"] }]`: fuel per km against the
  usual for the buses driven (each fill against that bus with other drivers, else buses of its size). Orange when
  `excess_pct > 10`. Fuel counts for the bus's default driver that day.
- `summary`: the card beside the chart (`title` "Worth a Look" / "All Normal", `text`).

---

_Source: `fleet.md` § 8.9 Usage card: `GET /fuel/usage`_

get.description:
GET /trips/:trip_id/assignments?from=

```json
{ "data": {
  "as_of": "2026-10-30", "operator_cancel_rule": "done",
  "slots": [ { "key": "d1r0|2", "trip_run_id": 1, "run_key": "d1r0", "run_label": "07:45", "slot_no": 2,
               "assignee": "operator", "vehicle_id": 17, "plate": "PC7475L", "operator_id": 5, "operator_name": "Hup Seng Coaches",
               "pay_amount": "4500.0", "pay_basis": "month", "assignment_id": 1, "from": "2026-09-07" } ],
  "history": [ { "id": 1, "effective_from": "2026-09-07", "assignee": "operator", "operator_id": 5, "operator_name": "Hup Seng Coaches",
                 "vehicle_id": 17, "plate": "PC7475L", "pay_amount": "4500.0", "pay_basis": "month",
                 "slots": ["d1r0|2", "d1r1|2"], "by": "SimpleDrive Ops", "at": "..." } ]
} }
```

- `slots`: every run × vehicle slot with who runs it on `as_of` (`run_label`: "07:45" or "Return 17:30"). Non-shuttle trips have one key per vehicle: `trip|1`.
- `assignee`: `own`, `operator` (bus may be empty: operator named, bus not known yet), `none`.

| Action | Call |
| --- | --- |
| Give ticked runs | `POST /trips/:trip_id/assignments` `{ effective_from, slots: ["d1r0|1", ...], assignee: "own" | "operator" | "none", operator_id, vehicle_id, pay_amount, pay_basis: "run" | "day" | "month" }` |
| Remove a history entry | `DELETE /trips/:trip_id/assignments/:id` (those runs go back to what was before) |
| If the Client Cancels a Run | `PATCH /trips/:trip_id` `{ "trip": { "operator_cancel_rule": "done" | "full" } }` |

Pay per day is shared over the slots of the entry; per month also over the month's run days (`operator_cost` on each run).
`effective_from` may be past the horizon: the entry is kept and the runs take it when those dates are added.

---

_Source: `scheduler.md` § `GET /trips/:trip_id/assignments?from=`_

post.description:
POST /trips/:trip_id/route_list { document_read_id, joins, apply_from } — Apply From on a saved School Run.

1. `POST /document_reads` (multipart) `kind=route_list`, `file` (PDF, xlsx, csv, photo) → poll.
2. Review: `POST /route_lists/review` `{ document_read_id, joins: [bool per row] (optional), trip_id (when importing onto a saved trip) }`

```json
{ "data": {
  "meta": { "label": "AM 13", "session": "am", "school": "Red Swastika School", "school_address": "350 Bedok North Ave 3 469719",
            "start_date": "2026-11-09", "arrive_by": "07:20", "leave_by": null, "notes": "Attendant alights at Blk 120" },
  "joins": [false, true, false],
  "stops": [ { "name": "Blk 443A Bedok North", "time": "06:40", "address": "Blk 443A Bedok North 461443", "lat": null, "lng": null,
               "driver_note": "Blk 443A Shelter", "pickup_point_id": null, "postal_codes": ["461443", "462443"],
               "rows": [ { "index": 0, "name": "Lim Jia Hui", "class_name": "P3", "postal": "461443", "time": "06:40",
                           "phone": "91234567", "flags": [] } ] } ],
  "flagged": 2,
  "changes": { "added": ["Goh Mei"], "removed": ["Ali Hassan"], "changed": [ { "name": "Lim Jia Hui", "changed": ["time"], "before": { "time": "06:35" }, "after": { "time": "06:40" } } ] },
  "trip_attributes": { "kind": "school_run", "session": "am", "title": "Red Swastika School AM 13", "starts_on": "2026-11-09",
                       "days": [1,2,3,4,5], "end_mode": "never", "notes": "...", "stops_attributes": [ "stops with students_attributes" ] }
} }
```

- `joins[i] = true` = row i is in the same stop as the row above. Join Stop Above / Separate Stop = flip a value and call review again.
- `flags` per row: "No time", "Earlier than the row above", "No parent phone", "No postal code", "Also on <other School Run>".
  Checking postal codes against OneMap is done in the front end.
- Save Pick-up Point on a review stop: `POST /pickup_points` `{ "pickup_point": { name, postal_codes: [...] or "461443, 462443", lat, lng, note } }`;
  list `GET /pickup_points`; delete `DELETE /pickup_points/:id`. Review again to apply it.
3. Add to Trip:
   - New trip: put `trip_attributes` into the form (plus client, vehicles, price) and `POST /trips`.
   - Saved trip with students: `POST /trips/:trip_id/route_list` `{ document_read_id, joins, apply_from: "2026-11-09" }` →
     the current list becomes an Earlier List until the day before; returns the trip.
4. Earlier Lists: `GET /trips/:trip_id/route_list_versions` → `[{ id, name, valid_until, stops, students }]`.
5. Next 12 Months: `GET /trips/:trip_id/school_run_bill?from=` →
   `{ data: [{ month: "2026-11", runs: 13, no_school_days: 1, share: 0.9286, amount: "2228.57" }], meta: { total, empty_months } }`.

---

_Source: `scheduler.md` § 7.9 School Run: Import Route List_

`route_lists#apply`

   `{ data: [{ month: "2026-11", runs: 13, no_school_days: 1, share: 0.9286, amount: "2228.57" }], meta: { total, empty_months } }`.
